title: Fixed panels: Threshold file
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: Fixed sliding windows. Count the numbers in the result list that are at least k (greater than or equal to k).
descriptionMd:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
readings is a list of integers (numbers with no decimal part). It may be empty, and numbers may repeat unless Step 1 says otherwise. k is a whole number. Use it as described in the steps below.

Step 1: Build the result list
A window is a group of numbers next to each other. Take each window of exactly k numbers in readings, moving one place right each time. Record each window sum from left to right. If the whole input has fewer than k numbers, the result list is empty.

Step 2: Return the answer
Count the numbers in the result list that are at least k (greater than or equal to k). Return that count. An empty list gives 0.

Write your function
Complete fixedPanelsThresholdFile(readings, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
unitIntro: A window is a group of numbers next to each other. Take each window of exactly k numbers in readings, moving one place right each time. Record each window sum from left to right. If the whole input has fewer than k numbers, the result list is empty. Each card first builds this result list, then asks for a different answer. Start with the first card. The last card also uses position numbers that start at 1.
constraints: k is a whole number from 1 to 8. Answers fit in a signed 32-bit integer: -2,147,483,648 through 2,147,483,647.
Input numbers have no decimal part. They range from -1,000,000 to 1,000,000. Follow any extra input rules in Step 1.
Efficiency goal: time O(n); extra memory, including the result list, O(n). n is the input length. These labels describe how work and memory grow with the input.
